answer: Randomized Registration Window. Agents register during unpredictable windows derived from a public beacon, so attackers cannot precompute timing to batch identities. Admission slots are assigned by beacon-seeded lottery, and each admitted identity must post a plume of corroborating activity across independent channels before activation. Attackers must fund sustained real work per identity through the horizon of each window. Coalitions attempting volume face a rising timber of verification effort, since slots per beacon epoch are capped and correlated registrations are flagged.
